name: duck_cover_hold
text: Remain crouched very low with torso curled forward and both forearms protecting the head. Keep the head tucked behind the arms, slight breathing only.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 低蹲缩头、双臂护头的保持循环，头位于前臂后方；两秒首尾同姿势，无根前进量。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
